item.title: NSe — Future Boundary Conditions
item.description:
Cross-model, cross-scenario summary of NSe’s future open-boundary conditions: delta-change temperature/salinity (CMIP6, bias-corrected against the CMEMS Northwest Shelf reanalysis) and tidal elevation/currents (TPXO9 plus the CMIP6 ensemble-mean sea-level trend). Biogeochemical boundaries are not yet included here – CMIP6 ESM biogeochemistry is considerably simpler than the CMEMS regional product, and whether a delta-change approach is even appropriate for it is still under evaluation.

Delta-change (temperature / salinity)

Temperature (thetao)

Source: AMM7/AMM15 delta-change: GFDL-ESM4/ssp126 [1985-01-01–2014-12-31 vs 2015-01-01–2100-12-31]
